# A window in the back wall: a wooden frame (sides, head, sill, a cross of glazing bars) and the
# night outside (textures/night.png, unlit in the scene). Generated by make_env.py. Up Z, front -Y,
# origin at the bottom middle, on the wall's face.
new
material new Night --base-color 1 1 1 --no-slot
material texture Night base-color textures/night.png
material new Frame --base-color 0.6275 0.3137 0.0000 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name Panes --size 1 --location 0.0000 -0.0050 0.4700
scale 0.6600 0.0100 0.7800
apply --scale
material assign Night
select Panes
active Panes
mode edit
select face where "normal.y > -0.9"
delete only-faces
select all
uv project-from-view front --scale-to-bounds
mode object
add mesh cube --name SideL --size 1 --location -0.3650 -0.0300 0.4700
scale 0.0700 0.0600 0.9400
apply --scale
add mesh cube --name SideR --size 1 --location 0.3650 -0.0300 0.4700
scale 0.0700 0.0600 0.9400
apply --scale
add mesh cube --name Head --size 1 --location 0.0000 -0.0300 0.9000
scale 0.8000 0.0600 0.0800
apply --scale
add mesh cube --name Sill --size 1 --location 0.0000 -0.0550 0.0400
scale 0.9200 0.1100 0.0800
apply --scale
add mesh cube --name BarV --size 1 --location 0.0000 -0.0300 0.4700
scale 0.0500 0.0400 0.7800
apply --scale
add mesh cube --name BarH --size 1 --location 0.0000 -0.0300 0.4750
scale 0.6600 0.0400 0.0500
apply --scale
select SideL SideR Head Sill BarV BarH
material assign Frame
select Panes SideL SideR Head Sill BarV BarH
active SideL
join
select SideL
active SideL
mode edit
select face where "normal.y > 0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
shade flat
export window.glb
